branch_definitions.G10: PPO highest-scored legal non-KEEP Cache UPDATE + both UAVs STAY
branch_definitions.G01: KEEP + highest joint PPO probability formal legal non-STAY UAV candidate pair
branch_definitions.G11: same Cache UPDATE as G10 + exactly same UAV target coordinates as G01

delta_definitions.Q: sum of actual task utility from formal Matching/KKT
delta_definitions.G: formal slot system utility = Q - CacheCost - MovementCost
delta_definitions.relative_improvement_pct: 100 * delta / abs(G00 baseline component); undefined when denominator is zero

experiment.five_slot_design: four middle states, one per seed; first-slot action then fixed Cache and UAV positions for four actual later Training slots; no PPO reddecisions; undiscounted sums

runtime.numba: disabled via supported optional-dependency fallback (host installation import fails against NumPy 2.2.6)
